payload.question_text: What does a vision-enabled GPT model combine?

options.rationale: Editing and remixing are media-generation activities. They do not define GPT with vision.
options.better_fit: Use this for image editing or video-remix capabilities.

options.rationale: Vision-enabled GPT models interpret visual input. They respond in natural language.
Object detection is a narrow vision task. GPT with vision supports broader visual reasoning and language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when only object identification is needed.

options.rationale: Text-only generation does not process visual input. Vision-enabled GPT combines visual understanding with language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when no image or other visual input is involved.

payload.explanation: Vision-enabled GPT combines visual understanding with natural-language responses. Do not confuse it with image or video generation; when an image is supplied, ask the model a question or request a description in natural language.

payload.question_text: Which data types can a multimodal model work with at the same time? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Text is a supported multimodal data type. It can be combined with other input types.

options.better_fit: Use this for an image-only processing task.

options.rationale: Images are a supported multimodal data type. They can be considered with written input.
Audio is another data type multimodal models can work with. Multimodal means more than one type of data.

payload.explanation: A multimodal model works with multiple data types, including text, images, audio, and video. Do not reduce multimodal input to images alone; when designing a request, identify the text and visual or other inputs to send together.

payload.question_text: A vision-enabled GPT model can understand images but cannot give natural-language responses.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A suitable model would be ruled out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Vision-enabled GPT combines image understanding with natural-language responses.

payload.explanation: Vision-enabled GPT combines image understanding and natural-language output. The misconception is that understanding an image prevents the model from replying in language; test it by supplying an image and asking for a text description or answer.

payload.question_text: Your team is choosing a platform to organize enterprise AI application development. What is Microsoft Foundry?

options.text: A screen for testing deployed models
options.rationale: This describes a playground rather than the full platform. A playground is one place for interactive testing.
options.better_fit: Use this for a question about testing a deployed model interactively.

options.rationale: An API is a code interface for sending requests. Foundry is the Azure platform that organizes enterprise AI work.
options.better_fit: Use this when code must send a model request.

options.text: An Azure platform for enterprise AI work
options.rationale: Microsoft Foundry is an Azure platform for enterprise AI operations and application development. It includes a model catalog and broader development capabilities.

options.better_fit: Use this when the task specifically requires creating or editing images.

payload.explanation: Microsoft Foundry is an Azure platform for enterprise AI operations and application development, not merely a playground, API, or model. Use the platform to select and deploy models and build applications; use the playground only for interactive testing.

payload.question_text: A multimodal model can use an image and text together to answer a question about a photo.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: One input would be left out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Multimodal models combine more than one type of data.

payload.explanation: Multimodal models can combine an image with text in one request to answer a photo question. Do not split the inputs automatically; attach the photo and written question together when the model supports both.

options.text: A support app analyzing customer photos

options.text: A tool generating only video clips

payload.explanation: AI applications and agents can use visual input to improve workflows—for example, analyzing photos, reviewing screenshots, or explaining charts. feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This narrows a platform to one testing activity.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry supports enterprise AI operations and application development.

options.better_fit: Use this when the task is generating a video.

payload.question_text: A learning tool can use visual input to explain diagrams or charts in plain language.

payload.question_text: A developer wants an image-aware system to interpret a photo and respond usefully. What is visual reasoning?

options.text: Drawing a new image from text

options.better_fit: Use this when a description must become an image.

options.rationale: Object detection is a specific visual task. Visual reasoning can interpret broader visual meaning.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is limited to identifying objects.

options.rationale: Image segmentation separates an image into regions. Visual reasoning interprets the visual information to form an informed response.
options.better_fit: Use this when image regions must be identified or separated.

options.text: Interpreting visual input and giving an informed response
options.rationale: Visual reasoning interprets what is visible. It produces an informed response, often in natural language.

payload.explanation: Visual reasoning interprets visual input and produces an informed response, beyond merely detecting objects, segmenting regions, or generating an image. To apply it, provide the photo with a question or instruction and use the model's response to guide the workflow.

payload.question_text: Foundry's catalog includes partner models that support text and image understanding.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Suitable partner choices could be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry includes Microsoft and partner models that support text and image understanding.

payload.explanation: Foundry's model catalog includes Microsoft and partner-provided models that support text and image understanding. Do not limit the catalog to Microsoft's own GPT models; compare available multimodal partner models when selecting a deployment.

payload.question_text: A developer is deciding whether one request can handle a user's written question and attached image. Is a separate vision pipeline always required?

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The team could add unnecessary processing steps.
